text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! The screen changed!
—It's starting, the pre-race press conference for the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, we've gathered the super-star lineup
of runners competing in tomorrow's
Takarazuka Kinen right here with us!”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Though it doesn't look like everyone is here...?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Wait, where are
Gold Ship-san and Epiphaneia-san!?

text_block_list.name: Shion & Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Looks kinda like Epi-san, though...
—Golshi, not that girl again...!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Um... Oh, they're holding up a cue card!
"Epiphaneia's Trainer and a detached staff unit
are currently pursuing the two of them"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Regretting that I wasn't able to hold Epiphaneia back, I chase after her. My gut tells me Gold Ship is definitely there too.
choice_data_list: (I'll have them patch in the broadcast to fill the gap...!)

text_block_list.name: Broadcast Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... haa...!!
My thighs are... burning...!
choice_data_list: Keep it up! Just a little further!

text_block_list.name: Broadcast Staff A
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Why... are you so... full of energy...agh!?
choice_data_list: I'm used to running around, so...!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Want a bite too?
Golshi roasted it in inferno for me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Beyond this point is their stronghold!
If you're here to sightsee, you'd better bring a rope ladder!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My heart was burning up! And so,
when I ran towards where the voice of destiny was pushing me—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"There's Golshi! That's right—
She's my biggest rival tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Broadcast Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hook up the broadcast feed!
Looks like we're gonna capture something interesting!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Man, you've got no sense.
Golshi-chan is out here pulling off a reverse dragon waterfall climb, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She's probably referring to her recent slump... I think.
Lately, her race results haven't been very consistent.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No! In the Takarazuka Kinen,
you will show everyone your tremendous strength!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny says so too.
So there's no doubt about it,
you're the one I have to defeat!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "I'll outshine the light of your star—and awaken the voices sleeping inside everyone!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...It was the day of your Make Debut, wasn't it?
When I became the "Chief".

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've known ever since then.
That one day, you'd come at me like a raging yellowtail—and try to eat me alive!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: From one chrysanthemum-garnishing sashimi pro to another, let me teach you—what true 'long distance' is all about!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! In that case, I'll just have to hit 'em
with supreme power!!

text_block_list.name: Broadcast Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"...Did that footage send properly?!
Man, this is gonna blow up...! All that effort chasing her down was worth it!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks!
I knew you'd come pick me up!
choice_data_list: Still, you can't just skip the press conference.
Still, you can't just skip the press conference.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! I just couldn't hold it in!
I've got a feeling about this!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I just know a voice will awaken inside everyone tomorrow!
I can really feel it...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —No, that's how it must be!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, keep a close eye on everyone, okay?
That way, if anyone's voice awakens, we'll know right away!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, yesterday's press conference was insane!
I never thought I'd see Golshi-chan get so passionate...!”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Because your opponent is Epi-chan!?
You're both Kikuka Sho Umamusume after all!
A clash between two tough, powerhouse girls... I can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Wow... The anticipation is incredible!"
"She really is a strong Umamusume, isn't she...!"
"Epi-san, go for it~~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd, along with the Umamusume who felt Epiphaneia's destiny,
were at the absolute peak of excitement.
If she could achieve a flawless victory in this atmosphereâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day I overtake you—
and seize the glory befitting of me!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohohoho...
...Please do your best.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's fighting spirit, their sense of anticipation...!
This is it, this is what it's all about!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win against all of them!
If I win—my dream will come true!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The voice!
You think so too, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: (—Ah, that's right!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—No!!
Not that voice!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let me hear it from your own voice!!
Otherwise...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, enough talk!
—Running will give us the answer!!
